result.summary: The page renders correctly overall; one suspicious content issue was found: a '-100%' discount badge on the partially visible pizza card, which is almost certainly a data/calculation error rather than a real promotion.

issues.description: The promo badge on the partially visible pizza card shows '-100%', which implies the item is completely free. A 100% discount is almost certainly a data or calculation error (e.g., missing price or divide-by-zero) and would mislead users.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount calculation and cap it at a valid value (e.g., -50%); check backend promo data and add validation to prevent impossible discount values from being displayed.
